description: Java class 'ModelFieldTypeReader' that reads and manages model field type definitions from XML configuration files within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ModelFieldTypeReader
classes.description: Class responsible for reading and caching model field type definitions from XML files in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createFieldTypeCache
methods.description: Creates a cache of ModelFieldType objects from an XML document element containing field type definitions.

methods.name: getModelFieldTypeReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ModelFieldTypeReader for a given helper name, loading configuration if necessary.

methods.name: getModelFieldType
methods.description: Returns a ModelFieldType object for a given field type name from the cache.
